tldr: Sun in the 10th house: identity becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With the Sun in the 10th house, this part of you develops through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
